title: Fail closed on broken symlink persistence slots
description: FileKeyStore and TwoSlotFilePersistence use Path.exists() to decide whether invalid slots exist. A broken symlink returns false, while the nofollow reader rejects it, so fail_closed=True can treat hostile/corrupt slot paths as a fresh empty store. Use lstat/is_symlink-aware existence checks and add regressions for broken symlinks in key TX and DAO TX/RX slots.
